department: Department of Statistical and Actuarial Sciences

deadline.value: International applicants: February 15; applications after the deadline will not be considered.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Not stated on the official pages checked

funding.value: The department publishes a minimum annual doctoral funding package (about CAD 26,600 for international students without an external scholarship); no all-admitted guarantee is stated.
funding.quote: The following amounts represent the minimum funding an awardee will receive in each scholarship category.

entry_route.value: An MSc with sufficient statistics, actuarial or financial-modelling background is expected; direct entry from an Honours degree needs at least 90% over the last two years.
entry_route.quote: Candidates with an MSc and sufficient background in statistics, actuarial science or financial modelling are eligible to apply for admission to the Statistics PhD program

notes: PhD covers Statistics, Actuarial Science and Financial Modelling fields.
